generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a low, twiggy shrub of thin stems with small, opposite, oval leaves and clusters of round white berries that last into winter. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 1.2 m tall at 12 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: dull blue-green leaves; white berries. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: small clusters of berries at the twig tips, pale green turning white. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: small pink bells in May to July; berries green, white from August, hanging through the winter. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

generator.program.note: The program the spec's authors chose to grow this form.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
